scope: Independent source review plus bounded pure/config/ownership controls; actual producer/TrainSink parity execution belongs to runtime agent.
controls: exact/within/overflow cap; prompt==cap and prompt>cap yield zero actions
all aligned node arrays independent; raw Episode bytes unchanged; excluded physical trace retained
destructive projected/sample cleanup preserves source and owned critic trajectory
raw full message/reward/call finish/Usage counts retained
tail-only gibberish/repetition removed; retained offending prefix still detected
mask holes preserve sampled-logprob mapping by retained True count
malformed arrays; prompt actions; disconnected/extra sampled/postresponse nodes; missing/multiple/failed/wrongly linked calls rejected
native train-only config; positive strict integers; inherited and explicit cap; JSON roundtrip
limitations: No prompt_overflow diagnostic: clipped only labels actual token-prefix reduction, avoiding unsupported boundary inference from arbitrary masks.
Projection uses a distinct canonical stop marker; exact historical stop-name spelling is not claimed. Raw source stop/reasons remain recorded.
Input canonical objects are not made globally immutable; projection owns its deep copy and retains source without mutating it.
No model/GPU or whole-producer parity claimed by these local controls.
